scope: Observed failure before the dollar-free minifier identifier fix; source-only Clay harness had passed.
cause: Clay inserts customFn.toString using a String.replace replacement string. A minified local ending in $ followed by bitwise & creates $&, expanding the matched template placeholder inside serialized JavaScript.
regression: The final audit executes actual packaged PKJS, fires showConfiguration, rejects leftover placeholders and opens the unchanged serialized custom function in Chromium.
